intent_snapshot.goal: Enforce global mandatory SupervisedSessionPort herdr transport for Authority Review and CLI Findings Verification, failing closed outside Herdr with review_preparation_failed (code review_transport_unavailable) and one same-Host recovery action while preserving QA attestation, retiring the hidden background --print process transport default/fallback across layered config, batch state, cli_review, Loop contracts, reference docs/mirrors, ADRs 0037/0039, and conformance tests per docs/specs/retire-process-review-transport.spec.md (BR-DEC-1, BR-REQ-1, BR-OUT-1, BR-SCN-2).

acceptance.assertion: Per docs/specs/retire-process-review-transport.spec.md AC1 and BR-SCN-2, writeProcessScript and all hidden background --print process review/verification execution fallbacks are retired from cli_review.ts; outside Herdr (no admitted herdr provider), Review and Verification preparation fails closed with state review_preparation_failed, code review_transport_unavailable, one same-Host Herdr recovery action (with no suggestion of lanes.review_transport process), preserves prior QA attestation intact across hosts, and maintains zero imports from runtime/session/ inside runtime/assurance/, Kernel, and Host adapters (BR-DEC-1, BR-OUT-1).

Per docs/specs/retire-process-review-transport.spec.md AC2, LANE_DEFAULTS.review_transport defaults to herdr, validateLane in layered_config.ts rejects process, and batch_state.ts (parseBatchReviewProfile, reviewProfileFromArgs, laneBatchReviewProfile) propagates only admitted herdr transport without process fallback (BR-DEC-1, BR-REQ-1).

Per docs/specs/retire-process-review-transport.spec.md AC3, docs/reference/immune-brain-config.md and docs/reference/supervised-session-port.md match their plugins/immune-brain/dist/docs/reference/* packaged mirrors byte-for-byte, dist/drive.md and dist/drive-batch.md retire process fallback prose, docs/adr/0037-authority-review-cli-stage.md and docs/adr/0039-verification-cli-stage.md record explicit Port retirement notes, and docs/adr/0038-supervised-session-port.md remains intact.

attestations.summary: Process --print review/verification transport retired: cli_review prepares only Herdr sessions and fails closed with review_transport_unavailable and a Herdr-only recovery, layered_config defaults to herdr and rejects process, coordinator and host_port drop review_command/verification_command, docs, mirrors and ADR 0037/0039 amendments match, and both bundles mirror the source; blast radius high (cli_review.ts, coordinator.ts, layered_config.ts, generated mcp-server bundles).

advisory_findings.summary: prepareReview/prepareVerification check reviewBinary before reviewSessionRunner, so a Host outside Herdr without the review executable fails with review_host_unavailable instead of review_transport_unavailable; the Herdr recovery appears only after the binary is installed.

evidence.trigger: HERDR_ENV unset and the review_host binary missing from PATH → review_preparation_failed carries code review_host_unavailable, not review_transport_unavailable

advisory_findings.summary: The retired Claude --print argv carried a read-only tool allow-list, dontAsk and disableAllHooks; the remaining Herdr session host arguments (from S1, unchanged here) depend on the tree-change guard rather than equivalent tool restrictions.

evidence.trigger: claude-code review_host in a Herdr session → the reviewer runs without the REVIEW_GIT_ALLOWED_TOOLS/dontAsk boundary the process path enforced; only treeChanged release detects a mutation
